ecrs_recommendations: Eliminate manual Excel updates and script downloads. Combine gold + diamond order tracking into one Kisna Force-integrated view. Rearrange communication routing so payment reminders bypass store managers and go to franchise partners / AOMs / support. Simplify vendor status updates through a single vendor dashboard.
process_name: Outsourced Gold Order Management & Vendor Coordination
solution_statement: "Kisna One" — a centralized order management and vendor coordination dashboard with automated status tracking, multi-channel (WhatsApp + email + in-app) notifications, and Kisna Force integration, covering the full outsourced-gold-order lifecycle from receipt through dispatch.
problem_statement: Kisna's 150+ stores route gold orders to ~25 outsourced vendors, but the order lifecycle is tracked in server-based Excel with manual scripts — leaving sales & support with no real-time visibility into vendor production, QC, payment or dispatch.
demo_prompt: See internal notes — demo built by Siddhi on Base44 covering vendor assignment, QC review, 7-day payment reminder, WhatsApp bot via Kisna number, logistics tracking integration, role-based access across admin/order/QC/payment teams, and management analytics.
